question: Why does the review recommend dissolving the aluminium foil in an alkaline solution to separate the cathode materials?

runs.text: The review does not recommend this. It presents dissolving aluminium foil in an alkaline solution as a method it considers unsustainable. rendered: The review does not recommend this. It presents dissolving aluminium foil in an alkaline solution as a method it considers unsustainable. The reason given is that recovering current collectors such as Cu and Al matters, because Cu smelting is a key source of SOx and other greenhouse gas emissions in the cradle-to-gate stages of the battery life cycle.[1] So the stated concern is sustainability: dissolving Al in an alkaline solution is judged not a sustainable way to separate the electrode materials.[2]
